description: Column pinning in the Svelte 5 data grid. A wide eight-column grid pins Company to the left and Unit price to the right through initialColumnPinning, so they stay sticky while the middle columns scroll under them; the header menu offers Pin to left, Pin to right and Unpin, and api.setColumnPinning does the same from code. Pinning needs columnVirtualization={false}, and the menu hides the pin items automatically when it is on.

faq.question: How do I pin a column on mount?
faq.answer: Pass initialColumnPinning={{ left: ['company'], right: ['price'] }} to <SvGrid>. Users can change it later from each header's menu, and api.setColumnPinning({ left, right }) sets it from code.

faq.question: Why must column virtualization be off?
faq.answer: The column virtualizer recycles DOM nodes, which breaks position: sticky. Set columnVirtualization={false} on grids that pin; the pin menu items are hidden while it is on so the two cannot conflict.

faq.question: Can pinned columns be resized?
faq.answer: Yes. columnResize is on in this demo and works on pinned columns like any other; the pinned edge keeps its position while the column grows.
